agent_discovery.description: Identify the object a person is pointing at in the current RGB camera scene. Use this read-only finite Skill for visible-scene or pointing questions; it reports evidence and uncertainty but does not infer depth or move the robot.
when_to_use: The user asks which visible object a person is pointing at.
A test needs one read-only VLM interpretation of the current RGB frame.
when_not_to_use: The task requires a 3D point, registered depth, motion, contact, or manipulation.
No current camera scene is available.
side_effects: Reads one current RGB frame from provider shared memory.
